@@ -53,10 +53,12 @@ void ena_devlink_disable_phc_param(struct devlink *devlink)
 {
 	union devlink_param_value value;
 
+	devl_lock(devlink);
 	value.vbool = false;

@@ -145,10 +147,12 @@ static int ena_devlink_configure_params(struct devlink *devlink)
 		return rc;

+	devl_lock(devlink);
 	value.vbool = ena_phc_is_enabled(adapter);
 	devl_param_driverinit_value_set(devlink,

 					value);
+	devl_unlock(devlink);
 
 	return 0;
 }

2.34.1

## Summary of Modifications

### File: `drivers/net/ethernet/amazon/ena/ena_devlink.c`

- **`ena_devlink_disable_phc_param` function**:  
  Added `devl_lock(devlink)` before the call to `devl_param_driverinit_value_set()` and `devl_unlock(devlink)` after it. This ensures the devlink lock is held while setting the driverinit parameter, preventing a lock assertion warning.

- **`ena_devlink_configure_params` function**:  
  Similarly added `devl_lock(devlink)` before and `devl_unlock(devlink)` after the call to `devl_param_driverinit_value_set()`, ensuring proper locking in this code path as well.

### Relationships

Both modifications address the same underlying issue: two distinct call sites (`ena_devlink_disable_phc_param` and `ena_devlink_configure_params`) were invoking `devl_param_driverinit_value_set()` without holding the required devlink lock. The patch consistently adds the missing lock/unlock operations at both locations, fixing the lockdep assert warning in both cases. These changes are independent but share the same fix pattern and are confined to the same source file.

Fixes: 816b52624cf6 ("net: ena: Control PHC enable through devlink")
Signed-off-by: Frank Liang <xiliang@redhat.com>
Reviewed-by: David Arinzon <darinzon@amazon.com>
Reviewed-by: Jiri Pirko <jiri@nvidia.com>
Link: https://patch.msgid.link/20251231145808.6103-1-xiliang@redhat.com
Signed-off-by: Jakub Kicinski <kuba@kernel.org>

Here is the root cause:
The `devl_param_driverinit_value_set()` function requires the devlink instance lock to be held, but the calls in `ena_devlink_disable_phc_param()` and `ena_devlink_configure_params()` were made without acquiring the lock, causing a lock assertion warning (devl_assert_locked).

Here is the patch:
 
 void ena_devlink_disable_phc_param(struct devlink *devlink)
 {
 	union devlink_param_value value;
 
+	devl_lock(devlink);
 	value.vbool = false;
 	devl_param_driverinit_value_set(devlink,
 					DEVLINK_PARAM_GENERIC_ID_ENABLE_PHC,
 					value);
+	devl_unlock(devlink);
 }
 
 
 static int ena_devlink_configure_params(struct devlink *devlink)
 {
 	struct ena_adapter *adapter = ENA_DEVLINK_PRIV(devlink);
 	union devlink_param_value value;
 	int rc;
 
 	rc = devlink_params_register(devlink, ena_devlink_params,
 				     ARRAY_SIZE(ena_devlink_params));
 	if (rc) {
 		netdev_err(adapter->netdev, "Failed to register devlink params\n");
 		return rc;
 	}
 
+	devl_lock(devlink);
 	value.vbool = ena_phc_is_enabled(adapter);
 	devl_param_driverinit_value_set(devlink,
 					DEVLINK_PARAM_GENERIC_ID_ENABLE_PHC,
 					value);
+	devl_unlock(devlink);
 
 	return 0;
 }
